ranks.textZh: 使你召唤小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔和地狱猎犬的施法时间减少2秒，法力值消耗降低20%。
ranks.textEn: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 2 sec and the Mana cost by 20%.

ranks.textZh: 使你召唤小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔和地狱猎犬的施法时间减少4秒，法力值消耗降低40%。
ranks.textEn: Reduces the casting time of your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, and Felhunter Summoning spells by 4 sec and the Mana cost by 40%.

talents.name: 屠戮
talents.reqText: 需要 15 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 使你的灵魂之火冷却时间缩短45%。当你对生命值低于35%的敌人施放暗影箭或灼热之痛时，这些法术造成的伤害提高3%，并且在接下来的10秒内，你的灵魂之火施法时间缩短20%，且不消耗灵魂碎片。
ranks.textEn: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 45%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 3% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 20% and costs no Soul Shards.

ranks.textZh: 使你的灵魂之火冷却时间缩短90%。当你对生命值低于35%的敌人施放暗影箭或灼热之痛时，这些法术造成的伤害提高6%，并且在接下来的10秒内，你的灵魂之火施法时间缩短40%，且不消耗灵魂碎片。
ranks.textEn: Reduces the cooldown of your Soul Fire spell by 90%. When you cast Shadow Bolt or Searing Pain on an enemy below 35% health, they deal 6% increased damage, and for the next 10 sec your Soul Fire spell has its cast time reduced by 40% and costs no Soul Shards.

talents.name: 恶魔支配
talents.reqText: 需要 15 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 你的下一个召唤小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔或地狱猎犬的法术施法时间减少5.5秒，法力消耗减少50%。
ranks.textEn: Your next Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Summon spell has its casting time reduced by 5.5 sec and its Mana cost reduced by 50%.

talents.name: 恶魔印记
talents.reqText: 需要 15 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 灼热之痛产生的威胁值降低17%，并给目标施加持续10秒的标记。你的宠物接下来对该目标的2次攻击造成65至68点火焰或暗影伤害，伤害类型取决于宠物。只有造成暗影伤害时，才会产生高额威胁值。
ranks.textEn: Your Searing Pain generates 17% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 2 attacks against the target deal 65 to 68 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

ranks.textZh: 灼热之痛产生的威胁值降低33%，并给目标施加持续10秒的标记。你的宠物接下来对该目标的4次攻击造成65至68点火焰或暗影伤害，伤害类型取决于宠物。只有造成暗影伤害时，才会产生高额威胁值。
ranks.textEn: Your Searing Pain generates 33% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 4 attacks against the target deal 65 to 68 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

ranks.textZh: 灼热之痛产生的威胁值降低50%，并给目标施加持续10秒的标记。你的宠物接下来对该目标的6次攻击造成65至68点火焰或暗影伤害，伤害类型取决于宠物。只有造成暗影伤害时，才会产生高额威胁值。
ranks.textEn: Your Searing Pain generates 50% less threat and brands the target for 10 sec. Your pet's next 6 attacks against the target deal 65 to 68 Fire or Shadow damage based on the pet. If Shadow damage is dealt, it has high threat.

talents.name: 强化地狱猎犬
talents.reqText: 需要 20 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 使你的地狱猎犬的腐坏之血的攻击强度降低效果、吞噬魔法的治疗效果以及多疑的侦测等级提高10%，并使其法术封锁的冷却时间缩短2秒。
ranks.textEn: Increases the Attack Power reduction of your Felhunter's Tainted Blood, the healing of its Devour Magic, and the detection level of its Paranoia by 10%, and reduces the cooldown of its Spell Lock by 2 sec.

ranks.textZh: 使你的地狱猎犬的腐坏之血的攻击强度降低效果、吞噬魔法的治疗效果以及多疑的侦测等级提高20%，并使其法术封锁的冷却时间缩短4秒。

talents.name: 灵魂链接
talents.reqText: 需要 20 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 激活时，施法者受到的所有伤害有30%由你的小鬼、虚空行者、魅魔、夜魔或地狱猎犬恶魔承受。此外，恶魔和主人造成的伤害都提高3%。只要恶魔处于激活状态，该效果就会持续。
ranks.textEn: When active, 30% of all damage taken by the caster is taken by your Imp, Voidwalker, Succubus, Incubus, or Felhunter Demon instead. In addition, both the Demon and the master will inflict 3% more damage. Lasts as long as the Demon is active.

talents.name: 恶魔知识
talents.reqText: 需要 20 点在 恶魔学识 天赋中

ranks.textEn: Increases your spell damage and your Demon pet's spell damage by up to 33% of your level while you have a summoned Demon pet active.

ranks.textZh: 召唤的恶魔宠物激活时，使你和恶魔宠物的法术伤害最多提高相当于你等级67%的数值。

talents.name: 浩劫灾祸
talents.reqText: 需要 20 点在 毁灭 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 使目标遭受浩劫灾祸，持续5分钟，术士对其他目标造成的所有伤害有15%也会施加给被诅咒的目标。浩劫灾祸只能影响1个目标，且每个术士在任一目标身上只能维持一种灾祸。
ranks.textEn: Afflicts the target for 5 min, causing 15% of all damage done by the Warlock to other targets to also be dealt to the cursed target. Bane of Havoc is limited to 1 target, and only one Bane per Warlock can be active on any one target.

ranks.textZh: 使你的燃烧法术爆击几率提高8%。

talents.name: 影与焰
talents.reqText: 需要 25 点在 毁灭 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 使用燃烧击中敌人后，你造成的所有暗影伤害提高2%，持续20秒。使用暗影灼烧击中敌人后，你造成的所有火焰伤害提高2%，持续20秒。此外，燃烧有20%的几率不消耗献祭，暗影灼烧有20%的几率立刻返还一块灵魂碎片。
ranks.textEn: Hitting an enemy with Conflagrate increases all Shadow damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec, and hitting an enemy with Shadowburn increases all Fire damage you deal by 2% for 20 sec. In addition, Conflagrate has a 20% chance not to consume Immolate, and Shadowburn has a 20% chance to instantly refund a Soul Shard.

talents.name: 烧尽
talents.reqText: 需要 30 点在 毁灭 天赋中

ranks.textZh: 对你的目标造成90到104点火焰伤害，如果目标受到献祭的影响，则额外造成25%的伤害。
ranks.textEn: Deals 90 to 104 Fire damage to your target and an additional 25% damage if the target is afflicted by Immolate.
